name: pursuit_snare_b
character: The second stick of the roll: a hair sharp, a little to the right and a touch brighter, so one sample is not played sixteen times alike.
description: The second stick of the roll: a hair sharp, a little to the right and a touch brighter, so one sample is not played sixteen times alike.
sources: KB cinematic-hybrid-scoring (a pulse that does not stop, low brass and sub weight at the turning points, constant percussion, a rising device)
KB soundfont-velocity-and-realism (a General MIDI SoundFont has one sample per key: velocity moves level, so the colour is added by velocity_timbre and the section by ensemble)
ESTIMATE: azimuth, distance, level and EQ are starting values for this piece, not measured; trim and balance are set after the first measured render

v05 director note: an SF2 holds one snare sample per velocity zone; alternate the stick by pan (+18 deg), pitch (+10 cents) and lowpass so a fast roll stops reading as machine-gun. Starting values; not auditioned.
